articles.summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. (“Dentsply Sirona” or the "Company") (Nasdaq: XRAY) today announced that the Company will participate in the Baird 2026 Global Healthcare Conference. Management is scheduled to present on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 11:25
